ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels across >85% of the visible surface area, with high-intensity (white) pixels localized to scarring and rake marks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous black pigment covering the central and lower lobes. High-contrast white markings are distributed as linear sets on the distal left lobe and as circular/irregular clusters on the upper and distal right lobe. White-pixel concentration peaks at the extreme lateral tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal pixel angle of approximately 50-55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations; pixel-amplitude variations of 10-25 pixels creating a jagged profile along the entire trailing boundary. Serrations are more pronounced on the outer thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Overall convex curvature on the trailing edges, tapering from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular white pixel clusters (5-15 pixels in diameter) localized primarily on the right lobe mid-section and along the lower trailing margins.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Highly distinct white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks); 4-5 parallel diagonal lines on the upper-left lobe and intersecting multi-directional lines on the upper-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Brownish-grey calcified clusters (barnacles) visible on the extreme lateral tips of both lobes; extensive white rake marks across the upper dorsal-facing ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct white ring-shaped scar with a dark central pixel interior located in the upper-mid quadrant of the right lobe lobe.
